name: Inkling 2 Mini

inkling2-r9700-strix.summary: Inkling 2 Mini on a Lucebox (R9700 gfx1201 + Strix Halo gfx1151): dense layers, KV cache, 3-pass wavefront prefill, and DSpark drafter on R9700 with parallel 74/26 MoE expert verify, 79/21 LM-head split, and Split-KV Global Attention on Strix Halo
inkling2-r9700-strix.notes: Peak single-stream decode on Lucebox (up to 155.4 tok/s code, 136.5 tok/s HTTP greedy) with automatic thermal fallback to R9700-only if the shared APU slows down.

inkling2-r9700.summary: Inkling 2 Mini monolithic on one R9700 (gfx1201) with auto-discovered DSpark speculator, 3-pass wavefront prefill, and Q8_0 KV cache (auto-fits up to 262K context in 32 GB)
inkling2-r9700.notes: Default on R9700-only hosts, or selectable on a Lucebox with --profile inkling2-r9700 to leave Strix Halo free. Holds up to 262K Q8_0 KV (4,556 MiB) + 3,072 MiB DSpark in 32 GB VRAM.

inkling2-strix.summary: Inkling 2 Mini monolithic on a Strix Halo-only host (gfx1151, hip:0) with auto-discovered DSpark speculator and 262K Q8_0 KV cache
inkling2-strix.notes: Default on Strix Halo-only systems where gfx1151 is hip:0.

inkling2-halo.summary: Inkling 2 Mini on a Lucebox's Strix Halo (gfx1151, hip:1) with auto-discovered DSpark speculator and 262K Q8_0 KV cache, leaving the R9700 (hip:0) free
inkling2-halo.notes: Mirrors qwen38-halo: keeps hip:0 (R9700) free for image generation or another LLM while serving Inkling 2 Mini on hip:1.

notes: Thinking Machines Lab Inkling 2 Mini (inkling2_loop, 24 physical layers -> 48 effective visits, 128 MoE top-8 with SITU, 40 SWA-1024 + 8 Global layers, bundled DSpark block-8 speculator in mtp.safetensors).
